scope: JANUS.REPO_AUDIT Market reconciliation path required before LETTER GATE promotion

security_findings.requirement: Untrusted service_request_id must never be interpolated into generated shell source and must be filename-safe before path construction.
Every HOME candidate response must be packet-bound and fully verified before selection; invalid candidates must be quarantined and must not block later valid responses.
All fields consumed by the source-issue result-return step must be validated before a delivery receipt can be created or committed.
Repository-audit reconcile must use the common janus-machine-market-state-writer concurrency group.

nested audit result hash and request/target binding validation
HOME source commit/blob/path binding validation before receipt creation

invalid candidate cannot pin the queue ahead of a later valid candidate
path traversal and shell metacharacter identifier cases
workflow uses the adversarially tested selector module
no untrusted GitHub expression interpolation into shell source
